$comment: D-CSUBSET-NORETURN-NON-FUNCTION-OBJECT (P50 lane li) — the row demanded 'reject it loud' and its 'expect unanimous rejection' premise was REFUTED by measurement. MEASURED 2026-09-01, each reference probed SEPARATELY: clang 18.1.3 and MSVC 19.51.36231 reject `_Noreturn int x;`, but gcc 13.3.0 (-std=c2x) ACCEPTS it (rc=0) with warning "variable 'x' declared '_Noreturn'" and IGNORES the specifier — and the disjunction decides ACCEPTANCE, so an error would put DSS below the union. DSS therefore warns S_NoreturnNonFunctionObject and drops the specifier, gcc's exact meaning; the one unanimous reject in the family (`struct S { _Noreturn int m; };`) is already a loud parse error on all three references and in DSS. exit 42 = 42 + x with x an ordinary zero-initialized tentative — the exit code proves the specifier was DROPPED, not honored. Release pipeline + all four targets because the boundary claim is 'DSS BUILDS AND RUNS this', per-target.
$noExpectDiagnosticsComment: ⚠ DELIBERATELY NO `expectDiagnostics` — the const_bitfield_write_warns precedent, same split for the same reason: the runner treats any manifest carrying that key as an EXPECT-ERROR entry (asserts the compile was REJECTED and never runs the artifact), which is exactly the verdict this shape must NOT draw. THAT the warning fires, fires ONCE per declaration, and leaves the build green is pinned by SemanticAnalyzerC.NoreturnKeywordOnNonFunctionWarnsAndStillCompiles (count == 1 AND !hasErrors()); THAT the program is still built, still runs, and computes with x as a plain int is pinned HERE by an executing artifact on four targets. Neither instrument can hold the other's half.
